meta.title: Next input suggestions
meta.description: When a conversation turn completes and the composer is empty, check recent messages for a clear unmet requirement and show one clickable suggestion above the composer. Clicking fills an empty draft without sending; existing text, attachments and native placeholders stay unchanged. No gap produces no visible suggestion. Failures and timeouts show only a dismissible notice. Explicit unresolved items or a clearly deferred downstream step after a completed phase use a local preparation/preflight template; other cases send a bounded text excerpt to the last turn's model provider and incur additional usage. Access-blocked work yields evidence and approval preparation only, never consent or another access attempt. It executes no tools and writes no suggestion messages into the conversation. Earlier requirements and image-only details may be missed. Disabling stops suggestions and preserves any draft already filled.
